## Release notes

Wyrm for iPhone 1.1.0 is about playing together and playing the way slither
really plays. You can now see when your friends are on and jump into their
arena. The arena list finally shows every arena, not just a few, with its ping
and its country's flag. Wyrm now talks to the arena exactly like the web
client, and your custom skin goes in just as you built it. There's also Eyes
Back, 77 new Wyrm tags, a snake shadow, and a fix for the freeze some of you
hit after dying. Thanks for every report you sent. They made this update.

### What's new

- **See your friends play.** Friends who follow you back get a green dot when
  they're on Wyrm. In Messages, chats and Connections you see "Playing in
  Arena 4817" with the arena's flag and a **Join** button, or where they
  played last. Don't want to be seen? Settings â€º Privacy â€º Show my activity to
  friends.
- **Every arena, with real pings and flags.** The list used to hide most
  arenas (only about a third showed) and pinged only ten. Now every arena is
  there, with a ping measured the way the web client does and its country.
- **Your arena stays yours.** Home keeps the arena you picked instead of
  jumping to the lowest ping every time you open the app.
- **Eyes Back.** A new on-screen button: your snake's eyes look back while you
  steer, just like NTL VANCED.
- **77 Wyrm tags.** Cute, flowers, planets, whimsical and gothic stickers that
  hang from your snake. They show in Trails' "Try this skin" too.
- **Snake shadow.** The soft shadow from the original slither app, under every
  snake. Turn it on in Modes, for normal and assist separately.
- **Spine width.** Slide the spine from hidden to as wide as your snake.
- **Messages like Instagram.** A chat opens with the other player's face and
  name on top and their profile card at the start; faces sit beside their
  messages.
- **Team chat in the arena** no longer flashes the lobby. The bar and keyboard
  slide up from the bottom, upright or sideways, and back down after Send.
- **A smoother minimap.** Snakes glide across it instead of jumping, your own
  mark is a little bigger, and the last-death ring stands clear of its dot.

### Fixed

- The game could freeze after you died if the iPhone lost its graphics. It now
  shows "Wyrm needs a restart", saves your settings and closes cleanly.
- The sideways keyboard didn't come up for team chat in a match.
- The Auto restart button's size and opacity sliders did nothing.
- "Too Many Requests" could show under Global chat.
- Wyrm sent too many requests at once after a long break, so scores and boards
  sometimes failed to load.

### Heads up

- **Wyrm now plays like the web client.** It sends your steering at the web
  client's pace and gives up on an arena that hasn't let you in after 5
  seconds, like the original.
- **Your custom skin goes in exactly as you built it** (up to slither's
  limit). It used to be repeated to 256 beads.
- **Video trails and live voice on iPhone are still coming.**

---

## Changelog

All notable changes since the last release, 1.0.0 (107), stable. This release
also includes the test builds 1.0.1 (108/109) to 1.0.5 (113), which were never
released.

### [1.1.0] (114) - 2026-10-09

#### Added
- Friends' activity: a green dot on friends with Wyrm open; "Playing in Arena
  â€¦" with the arena's flag, time and Join, "Active now", or "Played in â€¦ Â· 2h
  ago" on Messages, the chat header and Connections (mutual follows only)
- Settings â€º Privacy â€º Show my activity to friends (off hides yours and
  theirs)
- Eyes Back on-screen button, NTL VANCED's steering at NTL's own 33 ms tick
- 77 Wyrm sticker tags, first in every tag picker
- Snake shadow and Spine width (Modes, normal and assist)
- Country flags beside arenas on the Play card and in the picker
- Instagram-style direct messages
- "Wyrm needs a restart" card when the graphics are lost, instead of a freeze

#### Changed
- Every directory arena is listed (108 of 144 were hidden) and every machine is
  pinged with the web client's `/ptc` check
- Steering is sent at the web client's pace (50 ms aim, 150 ms turn and boost)
- A join that hasn't spawned after 5 seconds is given up, as in the original;
  a Play while the last socket is closing waits a moment instead of failing
- A custom skin goes into the arena exactly as built, not repeated to 256
- Home keeps the arena you chose across launches
- Runs are sent 25 at a time and boards refresh once, not after every run
- Minimap snakes glide; your mark is 30 % bigger; the last-death ring has a
  clear gap
- The team chat composer slides with the keys and never flashes the lobby
- Avatars in chats are rounded squares everywhere
- The in-game name is capped at 24 bytes so it never cuts mid-letter

#### Fixed
- Freeze after a death when the GPU was lost
- No keyboard for team chat sideways in a match
- Auto restart's size and opacity sliders did nothing
- "Too Many Requests" under Global chat
- Request bursts after a long break hit the server's limits
- A crash report now carries the logs from before the crash, not the next
  launch's startup

#### Security
- New: when you play (menus, Ready Room, which arena, with AI, idle) is kept
  for 90 days so friends and I can see it; the privacy policy says so (it was
  also brought up to date: settings follow your account), and Settings â€º
  Privacy turns it off for friends
- Every other new setting follows your account like the rest
